race.description: Fore Design Flex Planning Mdn Plate
race.comment: A TIME TO KILL (1) has mixed his form in his debut prep but has produced his strongest efforts when ridden positive. Expect Callow to do just that from the sticky draw and try and put him on speed. Backs up quickly and rates a leading chance. TASSORO (9) finds the maiden win elusive but it certainly hasn't been without trying. Blinkers are reapplied on the quick back-up and he finds another suitable race. With a touch of luck from the sticky draw it could easily be his day. DIRTY DEAL (4) took a big step forward in his second outing when closing off nicely into the placings. Is open to further improvement and rates one of the main hopes. KARMA QUEEN (12) has been showing good early speed but just lacking the winning blow. Strips rock-hard fit now and should give another bold sight to her supporters.
